entries.title: Psalms 142:1
segments: An Instruction of David; A Prayer when he was in the cave. I cried to the LORD [with] my voice; with my voice I prayed to the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 142:2
segments: I poured out my prayer before Him; I declared my trouble before Him.

entries.title: Psalms 142:3
segments: When my spirit fainted within me, then You knew my path. In the way [in] which I walked they have secretly laid a snare for me.

entries.title: Psalms 142:4
segments: I looked on [my] right hand, and I watched, but no one recognized me; escape was lost to me; no man cared for my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 142:5
segments: I cried to You, O LORD; I said, You [are] my refuge [and] my portion in the land of the living.

entries.title: Psalms 142:6
segments: Hear my cry; for I am brought very low; deliver me from my pursuers; for they are stronger than I.

entries.title: Psalms 142:7
segments: Bring my soul out of prison that I may praise Your name; the righteous shall gather around me; for You shall reward me.
